verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Codex SDK can 'automate coding tasks, including jobs in CI' and that the terminal CLI can 'automate repeatable work.' Supporting items show per-run CLI flags such as `--cd` and `--search`, a scriptable `npx @openai/codex-security bulk-scan`, cloud automation, and background scheduled tasks. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive/exec invocation mode, CI setup or auth details (e.g. API keys in pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.
